messages:
maya-cs: Heads-up — AlderPoint renewal is due next week. They want to shorten to a 7-month term, request a one-time onboarding credit instead of a percent discount, and need EU vendor code + EORI on PO. DocuSign blocked by their treasury (requires local eID). Need finance + legal signoff on credit treatment and signature fallback. cc @harry-fin @sophia-legal

dylan-se: Whats the onboarding status? Any perf concerns where Dedicated would help?

maya-cs: Onboarding ~78%: SSO and ingest tests green, only schema validation and a compliance attestation pending. They asked for two enablement credits up front.

harry-fin: Give seat count and list price and I'll run numbers. Also need clarity: one-time credit vs percentage discount affects how we invoice/recognize revenue.

maya-cs: Seats 16 initial; list $155/seat/month; proposed start 2026-06-01; expect +2 in month 3. Customer prefers a $1,200 one-time onboarding credit (not a %).

harry-fin: Quick math: 16 * 155 * 7 = 17,360 pre-credit. With $1,200 credit => 16,160 net. If they want monthly invoices that's 2,480/mo pre-credit; we can apply credit to the first invoice. Accounting OK with one-time credit if applied at invoicing time, will treat as immediate reduction. Need PO with billing entity + vendor code + EORI for customs reporting.

sophia-legal: For KMS/attestation: we can accept customer-managed keys subject to signed attestation; I'll add a short addendum. For signatures: if DocuSign/local eID is blocked, accept secure portal upload of wet-signed PDF with a notarized letter if treasury requires. I'll include fallback language: "Alternate: secure-uploaded wet-scan accepted where local eID or third-party e-sign disallowed; customer must include signatory title and a treasury attestation."

dylan-se: Ops: we can provision temporary Dedicated for cutover window at low uplift. Recommend reserve 2 GPU nodes for 2 weeks.

maya-cs: Procurement asked if we can accept escrow holdback until schema validation finishes  they prefer escrow but will accept wire. Any policy?

harry-fin: Escrow is unusual for term renewals; finance prefers wire or card. If they insist on escrow we need legal & finance to review funds release conditions. Wire + PO is straightforward.

esign-bot: DocuSign: Envelope 0xC1e created by maya-cs — Status: attempt pending local-eID.

sophia-legal: I'll draft 7-month addendum + KMS attestation clause and include the secure-upload/notarization fallback. Will post to contracts thread by EOD.

maya-cs: Customer replied: treasury blocks third-party e-sign; they can do a local eID but DocuSign doesn't support it. They'll wet-sign, notarize, and upload. PO ETA: EOD Fri with EORI.

harry-fin: Fine from finance if PO has billing entity, vendor code, EORI and payment method (wire preferred). We'll apply $1,200 credit to first invoice and issue Net30 monthly invoices unless they prepay. Please send PO & wire details to billing@redwood.com.

olivia-enable: I'll block admin + technical sessions for week after sign (2026-06-08). Need final schema and compliance attestation before then to craft the first-week checklist.

dylan-se: I'll reserve the Dedicated nodes for 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-14 pending PO. Ops will flag any extension charges.

maya-cs: Plan recap: 1) Legal to post addendum & attestation clause by EOD; 2) Finance to confirm invoice cadence & apply onboarding credit on first invoice; 3) Customer to upload notarized wet-scan + PO with vendor code + EORI by EOD Fri; 4) Enablement + Dedicated reserved week after sign; 5) Ill update renewal tracker on PO upload. Closing loop here once PO and signed docs are in.
